units: <cite ref="Chagigah 14b:8">Ḥag. 14ᵇ</cite> (in a mystic passage) <he>כשאתם מגיעין אצל אבני ש׳ טהור וכ׳</he> when you arrive at the stones of pure marble, say not, water, water.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 10">Ex. R. s. 10</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 105">Midr. Till. to Ps. CV</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="Q01309"><he>פְּסִיפָּס</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:26">Num. R. s. 16</cite> (play on <cite ref="U02057"><he>ששי</he></cite>, <cite ref="Numbers 13:22">Num. XIII, 22</cite>) <he>שהיה בריא כש׳</he> he was as sound as a marble block; Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 7.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:10">Tosef. Ter. X, 10</cite>; a. fr.
